*Coming soon.* The opposite end of the spectrum from MNIST: <200 points, 4–13 features, 3 classes. These are too small to justify DYF's tree-plus-Louvain machinery, but they're the honest sanity check — does DYF *over-partition* tiny data when there's nothing to find?
